criteria.text: PRP indicated for proliferative/pre-proliferative diabetic retinopathy, severe diabetic macular edema with pre-proliferative retinopathy, or other proliferative retinopathies
criteria.source_span: Panretinal laser photocoagulation is indicated for the treatment or management of patients with proliferative or pre-proliferative diabetic retinopathy and patients with severe levels of diabetic macular edema associated with pre-proliferative retinopathy, and other proliferative retinopathies.

criteria.text: Treatment is withheld until the risk of visual loss outweighs the risks/side effects of treatment
criteria.source_span: treatment is withheld until the risk of visual loss outweighs the risks and side effects of the treatment

criteria.text: Medicare coverage limited to management of proliferative or pre-proliferative retinopathies
criteria.source_span: Medicare coverage of panretinal laser photocoagulation using a laser or xenon arc is limited to management of proliferative or pre-proliferative retinopathies.

criteria.text: Payment made only once during the global period of the initial procedure; subsequent sessions included in that allowance
criteria.source_span: Payment may be made only once during the global period of the initial procedure. Reimbursement for subsequent sessions in the postoperative period of the initial procedure is included in the allowance of the initial procedure.

criteria.text: Reimbursement not allowed to non-physician practitioners for performance of this procedure
criteria.source_span: reimbursement will not be allowed to non-physician practitioners for performance of the procedure addressed in this policy

criteria.text: Medical record must contain documentation fully supporting medical necessity
sub_conditions: results of pertinent diagnostic tests or procedures
criteria.source_span: The patient's medical record must contain documentation that fully supports the medical necessity for services included within this LCD.

notes: Jurisdictional claims-routing note and limitation-of-liability/refund boilerplate omitted as administrative, not testable coverage conditions.
